每个知识点的讲解；术语卡、公式页和索引都是从它写出来的。: The explanation of each knowledge point; the term cards, the formula page and the index are made from it.
术语卡：每个术语一张卡，写在讲解之后。: Term cards: one card per term, written after the explanations.
公式页：把讲解里的公式按章节列成一页，不需要再调用模型。: Formula page: the formulas of the explanations listed by chapter on one page; no further model calls.
索引：按字母排的术语表和按章节的卡片目录，不需要再调用模型。: Index: an A–Z glossary and the cards by chapter; no further model calls.
易混对照：把相反或并列的术语成对比较，会多调用几次模型。: Confusable pairs: opposite or parallel terms compared in pairs; this adds model calls.
答题模板：从样卷里的题归纳答题套路；没有样卷就不会生成。: Answer templates: answering patterns drawn from the sample paper's questions; nothing is made without a sample paper.
速查表：把卡片、模板、对照和公式排成可打印的一页，不需要再调用模型。: Cheat sheet: cards, templates, comparisons and formulas on one printable page; no further model calls.
